title: AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.21691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. % \sysname pioneers the formulation of structured c

translated_title: AdaFlowLite：面向异步移动数据的可扩展且无阻塞的推理
translated_abstract: 配备激光雷达（LiDAR）和摄像头等多种传感器的移动设备的兴起，推动了多模态深度智能在分布式感知任务中的应用，例如智能座舱和驾驶辅助。然而，由于模态数据大小和网络动态性的影响，移动传感数据的到达时间各不相同，这可能导致延迟（如果等待较慢的数据）或精度下降（如果不等待就直接进行推理）。此外，移动系统的多样性和动态特性进一步加剧了这一挑战。为此，我们提出向“机会主义”推理转变，针对异步分布式多模态数据，实现部分数据到达即可进行推理。虽然现有方法侧重于优化模态一致性和互补性（即模态亲和性，modal affinity），但它们缺乏一种“计算性”方法来在开放世界的移动环境中控制这种亲和性。AdaFlowLite 率先提出了结构化的……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出AdaFlowLite，通过机会主义推理机制实现异步移动多模态数据部分到达即可执行的可扩展无阻塞推理，并率先提出在开放世界移动环境中以计算方式控制模态亲和性的结构化方法。
en_tdlr: AdaFlowLite enables scalable, non-blocking opportunistic inference on asynchronous mobile multi-modal data, pioneering a structured computational approach to control modal affinity in open-world mobile environments.
